# secureaccess_threat_category (Data Source)

This data source reads a Threat Category, found by its `id` or by its `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_threat_category" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Threat Category.

### Read-Only

- `command_and_control_callbacks` (Boolean) Specifies whether Command and Control Callbacks are enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Command and Control Callbacks).
- `cryptomining` (Boolean) Specifies whether Cryptomining is enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Cryptomining).
- `dns_tunneling_vpn` (Boolean) Specifies whether DNS Tunneling VPN is enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, DNS Tunneling VPN).
- `dynamic_dns` (Boolean) Specifies whether Dynamic DNS is enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Dynamic DNS).
- `malware` (Boolean) Specifies whether Malware is enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Malware).
- `newly_seen_domains` (Boolean) Specifies whether Newly Seen Domains are enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Newly Seen Domains).
- `phishing_attacks` (Boolean) Specifies whether Phishing Attacks are enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Phishing Attacks).
- `potentially_harmful_domains` (Boolean) Specifies whether Potentially Harmful Domains are enabled (Web UI Threat Categories, Potentially Harmful Domains).
